facts.text: Terranea Resort sits on 102 oceanfront acres on the Palos Verdes Peninsula.
facts.excerpt: Nestled along 102 oceanfront acres on the scenic Palos Verdes Peninsula

facts.text: The resort is in Rancho Palos Verdes.
facts.excerpt: aerial views of Terranea Resort in Rancho Palos Verdes

facts.text: The Palos Verdes Peninsula lies just south of Los Angeles.
facts.excerpt: Located on the lush Palos Verdes Peninsula just south of Los Angeles

facts.text: Terranea offers 270-degree panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: With luxury accommodations, impeccable service, and 270-degree panoramic views

facts.text: Guestrooms open to private balconies with views of the Pacific Ocean, Catalina Island, gardens or pools.
facts.excerpt: spacious guestrooms open to private balconies with sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean, Catalina Island, lush gardens, or sparkling pools

facts.text: The guestrooms are in the lobby building, near the resort's pools, dining venues and event spaces.
facts.excerpt: these elegant accommodations, nestled within the lobby building, are conveniently located near the resort

facts.text: Each suite has a separate half-bathroom and a living room with a stocked premium bar and pantry.
facts.excerpt: Each suite features a separate half-bathroom and a comfortable living room with a well-stocked premium bar and pantry.

facts.text: The casitas have gourmet kitchens, great rooms and optional adjoining bedrooms for families or groups.
facts.excerpt: spacious casitas, featuring gourmet kitchens, inviting great rooms, and optional adjoining bedrooms for the perfect family or group getaway

facts.text: The villas have expansive living spaces, a gourmet kitchen and a private garage.
facts.excerpt: With expansive living spaces, a gourmet kitchen, and a private garage, our villas are ideal for families or extended stays.

facts.text: The bungalows sit near the ocean's edge, steps from the oceanfront spa.
facts.excerpt: Situated near the ocean's edge and steps from our award-winning oceanfront spa, the bungalows at Terranea

facts.text: The Spa at Terranea is an oceanfront spa on the Palos Verdes Peninsula.
facts.excerpt: Nestled atop the stunning Palos Verdes Peninsula, The Spa at Terranea invites you to surrender to the rhythmic embrace of its oceanfront sanctuary.

facts.text: The Spa Pool offers lap swimming and private cabanas, with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Spa Pool, where you can swim invigorating laps or relax poolside in a private cabana

facts.text: The Spa Pool is for spa guests aged 18 and over.
facts.excerpt: (for Spa guests 18+)

facts.text: Fitness classes range from yoga and Pilates to seaside cycling, including a signature boot camp called Nature's Gym.
facts.excerpt: From yoga and Pilates to circuit training and seaside cycling, we offer classes for every fitness level, including our signature boot camp, Nature's Gym.

facts.text: The Links at Terranea is a 9-hole, par-3 oceanfront golf course on the bluffs above the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: The Links at Terranea is a 9-hole, par-3 Southern California oceanfront golf course set on the bluffs above the Pacific.

facts.text: Golfers walk The Links, with the coast alongside them.
facts.excerpt: because golfers walk The Links, the round unfolds at the pace the game was meant to keep, with the coast alongside them the whole way

facts.text: The Links has a multi-tiered short-game area with chipping and putting greens.
facts.excerpt: A multi-tiered short-game area with chipping and putting greens rounds out the setting.

facts.text: Terranea has 135,000 square feet of ocean-view meeting and event space.
facts.excerpt: With 135,000 square feet of flexible, ocean-view space

facts.text: Mar'sel's name blends the Spanish and French words for sea and salt, and it puts a twist on California cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Mar'sel, a fusion of Spanish and French words for "sea" and "salt," adds an inventive twist to California cuisine

facts.text: Nelson's is a casual oceanfront restaurant set among outdoor fire pits, with sunset views.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly nestled amid outdoor fire pits, this casual dining destination is ideal for a laid-back meal while enjoying unparalleled sunset vistas.

facts.text: Bashi serves modern Japanese-inspired cuisine with California ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Bashi brings a modern Japanese-inspired dining experience to the coast, blending traditional flavors with the abundance of fresh California ingredients.

facts.text: The resort's video features kayaking and dolphin watching.
facts.excerpt: ocean activities like kayaking and dolphin watching

facts.text: The spa is described as award-winning.
facts.excerpt: steps from our award-winning oceanfront spa
